summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend+frontend retest shows meal_points, badge fields, planning pattern/availability, avatar upload UI, RH badge/contract controls, DB-created-user password changes, and admin-to-user profile sync mostly work. However the exact reported flow is not fixed because contract_url is ignored on create/update so no Documents RH contract is created/visible, and Idriss profile password change accepts a wrong current password then the new password cannot be used to login due to hardcoded demo auth precedence. Auth is MOCKED via localStorage/X-Employee-Id; uploads are local /api/uploads.

critical.issue: contract_url/contract_name are not declared on UserCreate/UserUpdate, so FastAPI/Pydantic ignores them. Creating/updating a user with contract_url produced zero db.documents rows and /api/documents for that employee did not show 'Contrat de travail — {Nom}'.

For seeded Idriss, /me/change-password succeeds even with an incorrect current_password when no password field exists; after setting a new password, /api/auth/login with Idriss' new password returns 401 because hardcoded demo credentials reject before DB password fallback.

minor.issue: Code review: new contract docs are attempted with employee_id only, while /api/documents filters mainly by target_employee_id or missing target_employee_id. Once contract creation is fixed, verify the document is scoped to the employee and not accidentally visible globally.

ui_bugs.issue: Connected as Idriss, submitting current_password='wrong-current' closed the modal and showed success toast 'Mot de passe mis à jour' instead of an error.

integration_issues.flow: UserManager contract upload → user Documents RH
integration_issues.issue: UI contract upload control exists and shows the selected file, but because contract_url is not accepted/persisted by the backend user payload, saving a created/updated user will not create a visible Documents RH contract.
The UI success state does not match the required authentication outcome: wrong current password can succeed, and the changed password does not authenticate Idriss.

action_items: Add contract_url and contract_name to the backend user models, persist them, and create a Documents RH row on create/update; verify it is visible to the target employee in /api/documents and not leaked globally.

Fix /me/change-password to always verify current_password for seeded/demo users, and adjust /auth/login so a changed DB password for Idriss can authenticate (or synchronize demo credentials with the stored password).
Retest full save flow from UserManager contract upload through employee Documents RH after backend model fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: No relevant testing skill found from mandatory skill lookup.
Consulted auth testing playbook guidance; this app remains MOCKED auth using localStorage + X-Employee-Id, not JWT/cookies.
/app/backend/server.py UserCreate lines 3341-3390 has no contract_url/contract_name; admin_create_user checks data.get('contract_url') but data can never contain it through the API model.
/app/backend/server.py change_own_password only checks current_password when a stored password exists; seeded Idriss has no password field by default, so any current password is accepted.
/app/backend/server.py auth_login hardcoded credential branch raises 401 for Idriss when password != Idriss2026!, preventing fallback to the stored DB password written by change-password.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary qa.iter18.* users through /api/admin/users and deleted them. Temporarily changed/restored Idriss fields/password during password/profile-sync tests; cleanup verified no qa.iter18 users remain and Idriss has no lingering password field.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 focused on the enrichissement UserManager/Profil bug. Backend result has 11 pass / 5 fail; profile sync result has 2 pass / 0 fail. UI automation confirmed avatar preview upload and RH selectors/contract upload label; UI profile wrong-current password repro is in /app/test_reports/ui_iter18_profile. Ignore only Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/rum aborts in browser console.
rca_of_the_issue: Contract failure RCA: frontend stores uploaded URL in f.contract_url, but the FastAPI user payload model omits contract_url/contract_name, so Pydantic drops those fields and document creation branches never execute. Password failure RCA: seeded/demo users rely on hardcoded _LOGIN_CREDENTIALS and do not have a stored DB password; change-password therefore does not validate current_password, then login rejects the newly stored password before DB fallback.
